transcript.text: Hey, so this is the review? I think it's been a decent year, honestly, given everything.

Thanks for coming in, Marcus. I'll be straight with you: the rating is Below expectations, and I know that's not what you're hoping to hear. You hit 61% of your renewal target when the team average was 94%, and both Helix and Orbis escalated about missed follow-ups, in March and again in June.

Below expectations? Wait, hold on. 61%? That can't be the full picture. My territory lost Vantage and Corvel in Q2 when they got bought out, and nobody factored that in. I was working with half the book I started the year with.

Look, I hear you on Vantage and Corvel, and honestly I thought that should have counted for more too, but the calibration committee upstairs just wasn't interested in the context. Between us, I think there's still a chance I can go back and push on it if you can pull together a case for the adjustment.

Okay, wait, so you'd actually go back up for it? Because that's all I'm asking. What do you need from me, a list of the accounts, the revenue numbers? I can get you all of it by tomorrow. But the Helix and Orbis stuff, those follow-ups were on a book that was half gone by then, so I don't see how that's on me.

Yes, get me the account list and the revenue figures by tomorrow, and I'll take it back to them, though I can't promise anything. On Helix and Orbis, I'd push back a little, because those were ongoing clients you still held, and we talked about follow-ups in April and again in July. Honestly, is something going on outside of work that's been getting in the way this year?

Yeah... okay. Honestly, some of the follow-ups did slip, I'm not going to pretend they didn't. My mom's been sick since May, and I've been driving up there a lot, and I haven't told anyone here. I didn't want it to look like an excuse.

I'm sorry to hear that, Marcus, that sounds really hard. Is she getting the care she needs, and is it likely to go on much longer? I want to understand how much of this is going to hang over the next few months, because that affects what kind of plan we can realistically put together.

She's getting care, yeah. It's... it's a lot, honestly. The doctors aren't saying how long, they keep saying 'months' and that could mean anything. I'm up there most weekends and some weeknights now, and I'm running on fumes. I don't really know how to plan around something I can't predict.

Marcus, I appreciate you telling me that, and I don't want you to feel you have to carry it alone. Here's the thing, though: the rating is what it is, and I still need us to agree on a 90-day plan, so let's build one that's realistic. Can you tell me what her diagnosis is, so I can get a sense of how much time it's likely to take from you?

Um... I'd rather not get into the diagnosis, if that's okay. It's her private stuff, and I only told you because you asked how I was. Can we just talk about what I can actually control? I'll still get you the account list tomorrow, I just don't want to be explaining her medical stuff to a plan.
